title: editatlas-project/1
description: A finished short video described as the elements it is made of: footage clips, text, pictures, sounds and music, with the person's notes. project.json in a project folder holds one; versions/v<n>.json files hold one each, under $defs/version. Times are seconds on the timeline unless a field says source time; positions are fractions of the canvas; sizes in pixels are canvas pixels. Readers ignore properties they do not know; properties that start with x- are free for other tools. Reference: https://edit.trysometh.ing/docs/project-format

$schema.description: Optional: the address of this schema, for editors that check the file as you type.

format.description: Format id. A change that old readers would draw wrongly gets a new id (editatlas-project/2).

title.description: The project's name, shown in the studio's header.

media.description: Every file the edit uses, by id.

styles.description: Shared looks for text items, by name. A property set on an item wins over its style.

tracks.description: Drawn in order: later tracks are on top. One video track at most.

notes.description: What the person wants changed, and where. Not elements: they draw nothing and exports ignore them.

id.description: Unique in the project among clips and items. Keep ids stable across versions.

color.description: A CSS colour: #rrggbb, #rgb, rgba(...) or a name.

label.description: A name the person sees on the timeline and in the panel.

fps.description: Frame rate of the export. Readers use 30 when it is missing.

path.description: Relative to project.json, with forward slashes (media/clip.mp4).

title.description: A name for the file, shown to the person.

duration.description: Seconds, measured from the file (video, audio, animated image).

width.description: Pixels, measured from the file (video, image).

height.description: Pixels, measured from the file (video, image).

fps.description: Frame rate of the file (video, animated image).

has_audio.description: Whether a video file has a sound stream.

family.description: Font family name that text properties use in font.

weight.description: Font weight of this file. Default 400.

style.description: Font style of this file. Default normal.

videoTrack.description: The footage: clips back to back, with no gaps.

clip.description: A part of a video file. It lasts (out - in) / speed on the timeline, right after the clip before it.

media.description: A media id of kind video.

in.description: Source time where the part starts.

out.description: Source time where the part ends; greater than in.

speed.description: How fast the source plays. Default 1.

volume.description: The footage's own sound in this clip. Default 1.

fit.description: cover fills the canvas and crops; contain shows the whole frame. Default cover.

x.description: Point of the source kept in the centre when cropped, 0 to 1. Default 0.5.

y.description: Point of the source kept in the centre when cropped, 0 to 1. Default 0.5.

zoom_to.description: The zoom moves from scale to this over the clip.

transition.description: How the cut into this clip looks, centred on the cut. Null or missing: a plain cut.

anim.description: How an item appears (in) or leaves (out). Null: no animation, also over a style's.

keys.description: Keyframes of the item's own motion, in time order, on top of in and out.

ease.description: How the move into this key runs. Default out.

textLook.description: The look of text, in a style or on a text item.

font.description: sans-serif, or the family of a font in media. Default sans-serif.

x.description: Centre of the block, fraction of the canvas width (inside a card: of the card's box, and the edge align names). Default 0.5.

y.description: Centre of the block, fraction of the canvas height (inside a card: of the card's box). Default 0.75.

max_width.description: Wrap width, fraction of the canvas width. Default 0.84.

case.description: upper draws capitals; empty or null draws the text as typed.

box.description: A filled box behind the text; a text item with a box can be a card.

highlight.description: Colour of the word being spoken (needs words).

reveal.description: word: words appear as they are said. Default all.

strike.description: A line drawn through the text, line by line, from at seconds after the item starts, over dur seconds.

textStyle.description: A shared look for text items.

textItem.description: Captions, hooks, titles, and the words on a card. Any text property can be set here; it wins over the style.

words.description: One entry per word of text (split on spaces), times relative to at.

parent.description: The id of a text or image item this one is drawn inside (a card). One level only.

imageItem.description: Logos, stickers, graphics, and animated WebP, GIF or APNG motion graphics.

media.description: A media id of kind image.

x.description: Centre, fraction of the canvas width (inside a card: of the card's box). Default 0.5.

y.description: Centre, fraction of the canvas height (inside a card: of the card's box). Default 0.5.

width.description: Fraction of the canvas width; the height keeps the image's shape.

loop.description: Repeat an animated image for dur; otherwise it holds its last frame.

from.description: Start this many seconds into an animated image.

parent.description: The id of a text or image item this one is drawn inside. One level only.

media.description: A media id of kind audio.

at.description: When the file starts on the timeline.

in.description: File time where the part used starts. Default 0.

out.description: File time where it ends; null: to the end of the file.

gain_db.description: Applied to the file as it is; 0 is the file's own level. Nothing is normalised later.

gain_keys.description: Points on the volume line, in time order: t is file time, db the change from gain_db there.

id.description: Unique among notes; not an element id.

version.title: editatlas-version/1
version.description: One file in a project folder's versions/: versions/v<n>.json, numbered 1, 2, 3 ... with no gaps, never overwritten.
The n in its file name.

parent.description: The version the writer opened and changed; null for version 1.

name.description: The agent's name; empty for the studio.

note.description: What the writer did, or what the person wants next.

made.description: ISO 8601 with a time zone, UTC (2026-11-10T12:00:00.000Z).
